                "Stem": "Apex anticipates a temporary cash shortfall during a seasonal build. Which response is most appropriate?",
                "Choices": {
                        "A": "Record planned borrowing as sales revenue",
                        "B": "Ignore the shortfall if the income statement is profitable",
                        "C": "Use only accrual income to decide cash availability",
                        "D": "Use the cash budget to plan borrowing or investing while maintaining the minimum cash balance"
                },
                "CorrectChoice": "D",
                "ExplanationCorrect": "A cash budget helps plan financing needs and surplus investments independent of accrual income.",
